summary: Patrol, chase and flee pre-wired over Unity's NavMeshAgent.
overview: A wrapper around NavMeshAgent with the three usual behaviours already written, so dropping it on an agent gives real navmesh movement without hand-coding any of them. It needs an actual BAKED NavMesh in the scene.
useCases: Standard enemy patrol and chase behaviour.
An NPC that flees when threatened.
Switching behaviour from a perception event by setting state.

params.tuning: The whole behaviour switch. Drive it from perception rather than setting it once.
A straight-line target, so a flee can pick a point the navmesh cannot reach, and the agent gets as close as it can.

gotchas.title: It needs a baked NavMesh, not just a NavMeshAgent
gotchas.body: Without one the agent never moves and Unity says little about why. Window > AI > Navigation is the first place to look.

gotchas.title: Flee is away-from, not to-safety
gotchas.body: It picks a point in the opposite direction, which can be a dead end. Real escape routes need a smarter destination.
